in_hebrew.name: Beekman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Beekman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English name Beocca or Beohha, meaning 'bee' or 'beekeeper'. The name Beekman is a surname and translates to 'from Beekman's town' or 'from the man of Beeke's meadow'.

in_greek.name: Beekman
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Beaver man
in_greek.long_meaning: Beekman είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English name Beocca or Beohha, meaning 'bee' or 'beekeeper'. The name Beekman is a surname and translates to 'from Beekman's town' or 'from the man of Beeke's meadow'.

in_latin.name: Beekman
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Beaver man
in_latin.long_meaning: Beekman est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English name Beocca or Beohha, meaning 'bee' or 'beekeeper'. The name Beekman is a surname and translates to 'from Beekman's town' or 'from the man of Beeke's meadow'.
